shellCommands.command: git status --short && ls -la && cat package.json && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -100

cat app/UserDashboard.tsx; echo ----; cat app/page.tsx; echo ----; cat app/layout.tsx; echo ----; cat next.config.ts; echo ----; git diff package.json; echo ----; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/* | head -80
cd node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app; ls 01-getting-started 02-guides 03-api-reference 03-api-reference/* | head -150; cat 01-getting-started/*fetching* 2>/dev/null | head -400

cd node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app; cat 01-getting-started/08-caching.md | head -300; echo ======; grep -n -i "cacheComponents\|connection()\|dynamic = \|force-dynamic" 02-guides/caching-without-cache-components.md | head -30

cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app; sed -n 1,140p 02-guides/caching-without-cache-components.md; echo ======FETCH; grep -n -B2 -A12 "no-store\|cache: 'force-cache'\|dynamic rendering\|Deprecat" 03-api-reference/04-functions/fetch.md | head -120
cd /workspace && npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "tsc exit: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; timeout 300 npx next build 2>&1 | tail -40
git diff --stat tsconfig.json && git checkout tsconfig.json && git status --short
